lines.beaver: 야, 이게 얼마 만이야! 잘 지냈어?
lines.beaver_en: Hey, how long has it been! How have you been?
lines.beaver_roman: Ya, ige eolma maniya! Jal jinaesseo?
lines.learner: 응, 잘 지냈지. 고등학교 때가 그립다.
lines.en: Yeah, I've been well. I miss our high school days.
lines.roman: Eung, jal jinaetji. Godeunghakgyo ttaega geuripda.

lines.beaver_en: Me too. You were a well-known model student back then.
lines.learner: 모범생이자 조퇴 대장이었지. 기억 안 나?
lines.en: I was both a model student and the king of leaving early. Don't you remember?
lines.roman: Mobeomsaengija jotoe daejangieotji. Gieok an na?

lines.beaver_en: Right! You'd vanish right after lunch.
lines.en: The school meals weren't great, but now I miss them.

lines.beaver_en: How were the teachers? Anyone you remember?
lines.learner: 담임 선생님은 스승이자 친구 같은 분이셨어.
lines.en: Our homeroom teacher was both a mentor and a friend.
lines.roman: Damim seonsaengnimeun seuseungija chingu gateun bunisyeosseo.

lines.beaver_en: Remember the school trip? We went to Gyeongju.
lines.en: Yeah, the school trip is what I remember most.

lines.beaver_en: You practically lived in the reading room back then.
lines.learner: 의대 가려고 했는데 결국 법대 갔어.
lines.en: I wanted to go to med school, but ended up in law school.
lines.roman: Uidae garyeogo haenneunde gyeolguk beopdae gasseo.

lines.beaver_en: Law school, impressive! How was college life?
lines.en: When I came back from the army, the campus felt strange.

lines.beaver: 그래도 법대면 학벌 덕 좀 봤겠네.
lines.beaver_en: Still, a law degree must have helped with school ties.
lines.beaver_roman: Geuraedo beopdaemyeon hakbeol deok jom bwatgenne.
lines.en: I found skill matters more than school ties.

lines.beaver_en: I hear kids these days are busy with cram schools.
lines.learner: 우리 땐 사교육비 걱정은 덜했던 것 같아.
lines.en: I think we worried less about private education costs.
lines.roman: Uri ttaen sagyoyukbi geokjeongeun deolhaetdeon geot gata.

lines.beaver: 오늘 정말 즐거웠다. 다음에 또 보자!
lines.beaver_en: Today was really fun. Let's meet again!
lines.beaver_roman: Oneul jeongmal jeulgeowotda. Daeume tto boja!
lines.learner: 응, 다음엔 우리 고등학교에 같이 가 보자.
lines.en: Sure, next time let's visit our high school together.
lines.roman: Eung, daeumen uri godeunghakgyoe gachi ga boja.
